# A REPL result with a variablesReference expands and goes stale on resume.
> initialize
< {"body": {"supportsConfigurationDoneRequest": true}}
> launch
< {}
< event initialized
> configurationDone
< {}
> pause {"threadId": 1}
< {}
< event stopped {"reason": "pause", "threadId": 1}
> threads
< {"body": {"threads": [{"id": 1, "name": "main"}]}}
> stackTrace {"threadId": 1, "startFrame": 0, "levels": 20}
< {"body": {"stackFrames": [{"id": 1, "name": "main", "line": 1, "column": 1, "source": {"path": "/w/f1.zig"}}], "totalFrames": 1}}
> scopes {"frameId": 1}
< {"body": {"scopes": []}}
> evaluate {"expression": "s", "frameId": 1, "context": "repl"}
< {"body": {"result": "{...}", "variablesReference": 50, "namedVariables": 1, "type": "S"}}
> variables {"variablesReference": 50}
< {"body": {"variables": [{"name": "a", "value": "5", "variablesReference": 0}]}}
> continue {"threadId": 1}
< {}
> evaluate {"expression": "g", "context": "repl"}
< {"body": {"result": "7", "variablesReference": 0}}
> disconnect
< {}
